title: Exponential code bound
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $E,s\in\mathbb N$. Write $\kappa(N)$ for the code bound associated to $N$, and let $\ell(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ and $v(n)=\operatorname{size}(n)+1$. If $\kappa(N)\le E$, then $2^{\kappa(N)(s+\ell(|x|)+1)}\le 2^{2E v(|x|)+2Es}$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
